item.desc: Genealogy in Amharic, written in a mediocre hand. The text possibly starts ex abrupto.
item.q: ደጀን፡ ተክለ፡ ድብ፡ ገልገሌን፡ ገልገሌ፡ ዮሐንስን፡ ዮሐንስ፡ አዝማች፡ ስሎን፡ አዝማች፡ ስሎ፡ ማርያማይትን፡ አገባና፡ ስነ፡ የርጊስን፡ ይወልዳል።
ከዚያ፡ ወድቃለች፡ ከበር፡ ጐጆ፡ የኛስ፡ እመቤት፡ የላ፡ ቆንጆ፡ እንኳን፡
፲ ሰንሰለት፡ ፱ የግር፡ ብረት፡ ፬ ማጭድ፡ ፪ ምሳር፡ ፩ ፋስ፡ ፪ ጠገራ፡ ፪ ሞረድ፡ ፩ ማፈፍያ፡ ፩ የጠበንጃ፡ መፍቻ፡
በሰመ፡ ሚካኤል፡ ወገብርኤል፡ ባላምባራስ፡ ከበደ፡ ኮታን፡ ውድማ፡ ሲገዙ፡ ደኛው፡ አቶ፡ ግሹ።
በስመ፡ ጸሎት፡ በእንተ፡ ሕማመ፡ ፈንጻጻ፡ ሉድ፡ አልኩድ፡

item.desc: A message in Amharic, written in a very shaky hand that is difficult to read.
Mention of a secondary owner: Fitāwrāri Kabbada.

history.origin: According to the colophon, completed on 8 Maggābit 1886 E.C. = 16 April 1893.
history.provenance: The spaces left blank to be filled in with the owner’s name has been filled in, in a few places by a secondary hand, in purple ink with the name of Walatta Madḫǝn. Carlo Conti Rossini acquired the manuscript probably during his stay in Eritrea (1899–1903) or it was sent to him after his return to Europe.
